take a show to England with Lou Holtz, Luther Velez, Buck and Bubbles, Ruth Etting to do the show called "Transatlantic Rhythm" at the West Side Theater, called the Adelphia Theater in London. The show was really expensive, they packed the house but they couldn't pay off the showgirls, you see. So that's why the show didn't last but only four weeks. That's when we got the information to come back to America because Nazarro had a picture for us. And I'm fixin' on going to Australia. I just missed the boat to go to…
